caseName: Board of Comm'rs of Jefferson County v. City and County of Denver
caseNameFull: BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF JEFFERSON COUNTY, COLORADO, Et Al. v. CITY AND COUNTY OF DENVER, COLORADO, Et Al.
attorneys: Charles Ginsberg for appellants., Robert S. Wham, Richard P. Matsch, Charles S. Rhyne, Brice W. Rhyne and Alfred J. Tighe, Jr. for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
